query:
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot SEPARATOR ',') as bookedSlots
FROM delegateProfiles dp
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
WHERE dp.attendeeId IN ('113145184682','17812226737','93176107633','91862577670','200101377371','8196151','190937723960','93174643474')
GROUP BY dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
